title: Dandelion
description: A Beatles portrait printed in dandelion seeds, each tuft sized by the tone beneath it. Swipe across the face and the seeds lift off on the wind, tumbling away under their parachutes; leave it be and they drift back in and land where they grew.
intent: A halftone whose dots are alive: one breath of a mechanic, swipe speed and direction become wind, the face scatters into airborne seeds and slowly re-seeds itself, botanical and airy rather than digital.
